summary: One identity hold: s0062 supports Yuan Wenyao’s resignation and 侍養 but contains no 母 or other kinship surface for a distinct mother person. Proposed deltas retract mother-specific extraction on s0062 and remove the unstated English “mother”; do not invent a named mother or Chinese witness.

holds.independentHoldReason: Sealed primary beiqishu 038 s0062 has no Chinese 母 surface for descriptive-kinship or primary witness on p035.
holds.diagnosis: Primary Chinese s0062 reads 以天下方亂，遂解官侍養，隱於林慮山。 The predicate 解官侍養 documents Yuan Wenyao (p002) resigning for home filial care; it does not name 母 or individuate a mother actor. Extraction invented beiqishu:038:p035 “Mother of Yuan Wenyao” with descriptive-kinship zh:母 and kinship-reference surface “mother” on s0062 alone. English literal and idiomatic fields insert “his mother”, which is not attested in the Chinese unit. No other Yuan Wenyao biography unit in this chapter pairs 文遙 with 母. Owner prior witness quote “mother” (English) is invalid under native primary-witness rules.
